feeds.title: Davey Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Dive into recipes for meals that are quick, easy to prepare, and taste great, whatever your goal. Davey Nutrition is a world-leading team that is changinhg the way people view nutrition and mindset for good health and high performance.

feeds.title: SHEmazing! » Nutrition
feeds.description: Explore a diverse range of delicious, nutrient-dense recipes and tips. Catering to socially-aware, politically-savvy women who boast more than a passing grá for the lighter side of life, SHEmazing taps into the multifaceted lifestyle of young women in Ireland in a sometimes sassy, often irreverent but always relatable tone of voice.

feeds.title: Nutrition by Laurann Blog
feeds.description: Discover Nutrition and lifestyle Strategies for various health disorders, Nutrition for Sports recovery, and lots of insights on daily Nutrition. Nutrition by Laurann Blog is written by Associate Nutritionist Laurann O'Reilly who also offers Nutrition Consultations in Dublin.

feeds.title: AOB Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Explore AOB Nutrition's fantastic range of Supplements & Protein Bars showcasing crispy, tasteful, and nutritious products designed to provide maximum health benefits. AOB Nutrition is Ireland's buzzing online nutrition store with a vast selection of products ranging from protein supplements to snacks and bars and more

feeds.title: Ciara Ryan Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Keep up-to-date with Ciara Ryan's latest nuggets of wisdom, where she discusses everything from balanced diets, food & health tips along with regular tasty recipes. Ciara and her team are nutrition experts who specialize in hormonal health, digestive conditions, and metabolic weight loss in men and women with the power of nutrition.

feeds.title: Inside Out Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Gillian McConnell's Inside Out Nutrition blog educates readers on topics ranging from Nutrition Basics to Nutritional Science and Research Updates and Healthy Eating habits. Gillian is a State Registered Dietitian under CORU and is a member of the Irish Nutrition & Dietetic Institute which is the professional organization for Dietitians in Ireland.

feeds.title: Orla Walsh Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Orla Walsh is one of Ireland's leading dietitians and a thought leader in the areas of nutrition and health. Read Orla's latest evidence-based articles on the topics of health, nutrition, and lifestyle here. Stay informed and on track on your journey towards better health.

feeds.title: Irish Heart » Nutrition
feeds.description: The latest news articles covering the topic of Nutrition in Ireland. Keep your information fresh by engaging expert insights, guides, and more. Irish Heart is a non-profit organization that campaigns to influence Government policy in order to improve care for patients and to prevent premature deaths.

feeds.title: Discover Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Caroline Seale has a background in Nutritional Therapy, Health Coaching, and Functional Medicine. She has helped hundreds of her clients take control of their digestive health and get their lives back by looking at and treating the body as a whole system. Caroline has a proven 5 R Programme for Digestive Wellness that optimizes gut function to support overall health.

feeds.title: Eatwell Blog
feeds.description: Browse the Eatwell blog. Here you will find articles and information on various conditions, diseases, and general nutritional advice. Have a scroll or use the search function below if you are looking for something specific. Eatwell, founded by Sarah Keogh, is a reliable and authentic source of nutrition advice and information.

feeds.title: Think Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Mary Prunty is a Nutritional Therapist in Dublin. Her blog Think Nutrition delves into significant topics within the realm of Nutrition, providing simple, practical insight into Stress and de-stressing, Diet, Healthy Eating tips and more.

feeds.title: Cathriona Hodgins Blog
feeds.description: Cathriona Hodgins is a Nutritionist qualified in Nutritional Therapy from the Irish Institute of Nutrition and Health, Dublin. She offers information on how nutrition impacts your body, healthy practices, and nutrition-based recipes for the health-conscious.

feeds.title: Rachel Graham Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Rachel Graham is a Nutritional Therapist & Medicinal Chef with over 25 years of Food & Nutrition experience. Through her blog, her goal is to help clients discover ways to consistently eat healthier & therefore feel better!She also teaches medicinal cooking classes i.e. Fermentation, Sourdough Baking, Meal Prep, etc..

feeds.title: Whelehans Pharmacy Nutritional Blog
feeds.description: Scroll through a heap of Healthy Eating Plans, Nutritive tips, and Effective Meal Planning Ideas in Whelehans Pharmacy's Nutritional Blog. Created to provide trusted and digestible information on Health and Diet. Whelehans Pharmacy is a leading online retailer of various Health and skincare products operating across Ireland.

feeds.title: Willow Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: JESS WILLOW RD, is a Certified Fertility Dietitian & Intuitive Eating Counsellor. Her blog, Willow Nutrition aims to support individuals in reaching their goals from a friendly, realistic & evidence-based model. Read her insightful and educational writings on Fertility Reproductive Health & Intuitive Eating among other topics.

feeds.title: Lucy Looby Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Get back control of what you eat with Lucy Looby's Nutrition Blog. Explore nutritional recipes and evidence-based nutrition advice. Founded in 2018, Lucy Looby Nutrition is the place to go to improve your eating habits & general health. She provides direction and advice specific to you.

feeds.title: VY Nutrition Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Discover your path to a healthier lifestyle with regular tips and advice on the psychology of nutrition change. VY Nutrition Coaching is an online health service platform that provides health & nutrition packages for individuals motivated about their health concerns. Read informative, and engaging relevant articles in this blog to know more

feeds.title: Spectrum Health Blog
feeds.description: Looking for clinical information on diet, nutrition, and weight-related problems? Then you've come to the right place. Spectrum Health offers a range of private allied health services including corporate wellness, physiotherapy, podiatry, psychology, SLT, and diet & nutrition.

feeds.title: Glenville Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Glenville Nutrition specializes in male and female fertility, women's health, hormonal issues, weight loss, osteoporosis, and digestive issues. Our team are trusted nutrition experts and regular contributors to media including TV, radio and press.

feeds.title: Weaning.ie Blog
feeds.description: Nutrition, News, and tips about feeding babies, children, and families. I'm Cathy, a Mum of 3 with over 15 years of experience in CHI @ Temple Street. As a Senior Paediatric Dietitian, I know how valuable it is to introduce families to the nurturing foundations of food before any problems begin.
